name: Urborg
description: Urborg is a large, marshy island region of Dominaria with some of the most concentrated black mana, ruled by feuding witches and necromancers.

summary.text: Urborg is a large, marshy island region of Dominaria with some of the most concentrated black mana, ruled by feuding witches and necromancers.

citations.text: "Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: When Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex, Urborg became partially submerged and turned into a swamp, and Windgrace was born there.

citations.text: "Urborg", section "Aftermath of the Sylex Blast". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the Phyrexian Invasion, Urborg was one of the first places to fall, and the Stronghold was transplanted into a volcano there during the Rathi Overlay, becoming Phyrexian central command.

citations.text: "Urborg", section "First Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Stronghold (location)", section "Arrival and destruction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Multani transplanted part of Yavimaya to Urborg's edge for the last great battle, and the Coalition assaulted the Stronghold and stalled at the volcano.

citations.text: "Urborg", section "First Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Coalition", section "Battle at Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Yawgmoth emerged through the portal in the Stronghold, the Weatherlight was sacrificed over Urborg, and stone dwarves erupted the volcano to destroy the Stronghold.

citations.text: "Black Cloud of Death", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Black Cloud of Death", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Stronghold (location)", section "Arrival and destruction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the Time Spiral era, Venser lived in a workshop in the Urborg swamps, and Lord Windgrace closed the Urborg rift at the cost of his life, fusing his spirit to the land.

citations.text: "Venser", section "Life in Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Urborg", section "First Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Urborg", section "Windgrace's rule". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Sixty years after the Mending, Belzenlok's Cabal moved its capital to Urborg and retook the Stronghold, nearly wiping out the panther warriors.

citations.text: "Urborg", section "Under the Cabal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Stronghold (location)", section "Belzenlok". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The Weatherlight crew and the Gatewatch crossed Urborg to the Stronghold, where Yargle attacked the ship until Muldrotha seized it and dragged it into the swamp.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

bio.text: During the later Phyrexian invasion, Windgrace's Soul rose from the land to defend it, and Yargle ate enough Phyrexian oil to clean up most of Urborg.

citations.text: "Urborg", section "Second Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Yargle, Glutton of Urborg (Multiverse Legends, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

status.text: The latest story shows Yargle having cleaned most of the Phyrexian oil from Urborg, with Windgrace's Soul defending the land during the invasion.

citations.text: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg (Multiverse Legends, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
"Urborg", section "Second Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex, Urborg becomes partially submerged and turns into a swamp; Windgrace is born.
timeline.quote: the jungle island of Urborg became partially submerged and turned into a swamp

citation.text: "Urborg", section "Aftermath of the Sylex Blast". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Legend says the lich Nevinyrral was outmaneuvered and the city of Urborg swallowed by a volcano.
timeline.quote: the city of Urborg was swallowed by a volcano

citation.text: "Urborg", section "Aftermath of the Sylex Blast". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Many renowned swordsmen die in Urborg, outmatched by Gwendlyn's wiles.
timeline.quote: Urborg became the final resting place of many swordsmen of renown, their steel outmatched by the wiles of Gwendlyn.

citation.text: Gwendlyn Di Corci (Legends, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nevinyrral destroys the City of Urborg ages ago.
timeline.quote: destroyed ages ago by Nevinyrral

citation.text: "The Domains", section "Locations in the Domains". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Multani transplants a piece of Yavimaya's forest onto Urborg.
timeline.quote: transplanted on the island by Multani

citation.text: "The Domains", section "Locations in the Domains". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At least one lhurgoyf is found in Urborg by the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: at least one lhurgoyf was to be found in Urborg

citation.text: "Lhurgoyf", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel visits Urborg to recruit Lord Windgrace, who rejects him; Ravidel takes a shard of Urborgan obsidian.
timeline.quote: Before departing, Ravidel took a shard of Urborgan obsidian with him

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel visits Urborg and fails to convince Lord Windgrace, an isolationist, to join him; he takes a chunk of obsidian.
timeline.quote: Ravidel leaves, not able to convince the panther warrior .

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Journeying Angel , by Art Holcomb". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek says night stalkers of Urborg are willing tools in plundering Femeref.
timeline.quote: Their sad eagerness to elevate themselves makes them willing tools in the plundering of little Femeref."

citation.text: Feral Shadow (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Purraj of Urborg tells a victim why he accepts forbidden gifts as they die.
timeline.quote: "As you breathe your last, understand why I accept such forbidden gifts."

citation.text: Dark Privilege (Multiverse Gift Box, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Purraj sang slaughter and danced death.
timeline.quote: Purraj sang slaughter and danced death.

citation.text: Song of Blood (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Predator battles Weatherlight over Urborg; Ertai captures Gerrard and teleports him into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: managed to capture Gerrard and teleport him directly into the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth kills Greven and Predator is destroyed by being sent crashing into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Greven himself was killed by Tahngarth.

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The ship is destroyed by the Primeval Crosis and reborn as a sentient being, then destroyed a final time over Urborg.
timeline.quote: The ship was destroyed by the Primeval Crosis , only to be reborn as a completely sentient being.

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax leaves Urborg to join the Weatherlight crew, taking the artifact binding Selenia.
timeline.quote: He took with him the artifact controlling Selenia so that he could be with her.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexian agents Morinfen and Gallowbraid slaughter Crovax's family; Rofellos dies and Selenia defeats the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Rofellos became the first casualty of the battle.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Serving aboard Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Predator intercepts Weatherlight at Urborg; Greven's mind is dominated by Crovax and Tahngarth kills him.
timeline.quote: Greven soon fell beneath the raging minotaur

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Demise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax shatters the artifact binding Selenia, who flies away, and he is cursed to destroy all that he loves.
timeline.quote: He was now destined to destroy all that he loved.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gallowbraid slays Rofellos and Crovax summons Selenia.
timeline.quote: When Rofellos was slain by Gallowbraid, Crovax used his cursed heirloom to summon the guardian angel Selenia

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Mirri leave the Weatherlight crew, blaming the Legacy for Rofellos's death.
timeline.quote: Gerrard, with Mirri in tow, left the crew of the Weatherlight

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion, Multani transplants part of Yavimaya to Urborg's edge for the last great battle.
timeline.quote: Multani transplanted part of Yavimaya to Urborg 's edge

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Rathi Overlay, Crovax oversees Phyrexian domination of Urborg, executes Tsabo Tavoc, and convinces Gerrard to submit to Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: This convinced Gerrard to surrender himself to the Dark Lord.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax leads the counterattack against Multani's Yavimaya, raising the undead.
timeline.quote: He demonstrated his necromantic abilities by raising an army of the undead

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Urborg Rith reveals that the other four Primevals must sacrifice themselves, and that Darigaaz is himself the red Primeval; they throw themselves into Crosis' tar pit, freeing him.
timeline.quote: Darigaaz and the other Primevals threw themselves into Crosis' tar pit prison, freeing him.

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Freeing Crosis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the battle of Urborg the Weatherlight is destroyed by the Primevals; Karn has it reborn with the Thran Tome, giving it a consciousness that displaces Multani.
timeline.quote: Karn was able to use the Thran Tome to have the ship reborn

citation.text: "Multani", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Multani transplants a section of Yavimaya and its defenders to Urborg, spending nearly all his power and disappearing.
timeline.quote: Multani transplanted a few miles of Yavimaya and several of its most powerful defenders to Urborg

citation.text: "Multani", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, Urza and Karn merge to complete the Legacy, defeating Yawgmoth; Weatherlight sinks near Urborg, leaving Sisay without a ship.
timeline.quote: leaving Sisay adrift without a ship to captain

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ebony treefolk savagely defend Urborg against the Phyrexian invaders.
timeline.quote: Ebony treefolk savagely defended Urborg against the Phyrexian invaders.

citation.text: "Treefolk", section "Ebony Treefolk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Rith is freed from the Magnigoth tree that imprisoned her, Magnigoth treefolk chase her across Dominaria and catch her in Urborg.
timeline.quote: a group of Magnigoth treefolk chased her across Dominaria before eventually catching the dragon in Urborg .

citation.text: "Treefolk", section "Magnigoth Treefolk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urborg is one of the first places to fall to Phyrexia, and the Stronghold is transplanted into a volcano during the Rathi Overlay.
timeline.quote: Urborg was one of the first places to fall into the hands of Phyrexia

citation.text: "Urborg", section "First Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Multani transplants part of Yavimaya to Urborg's edge for the last great battle, in whose skies Yawgmoth is finally defeated.
timeline.quote: It was in the skies over Urborg that Yawgmoth was finally defeated

citation.text: "Urborg", section "First Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Windgrace closes the time rift above the Stronghold ruins at the cost of his life.
timeline.quote: The time rift was closed by Lord Windgrace at the expense of his life.

citation.text: "Urborg", section "First Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza takes the Weatherlight and metathran to Urborg; Crovax cannibalizes Tsabo Tavoc.
timeline.quote: Crovax , the leader of the invasion, cannibalizes Tsabo Tavoc for her failures.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agnate's metathran, caught in quicksand, are saved by Dralnu's undead, and they ally against the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: are caught in quicksand but are saved by the undead of lich lord Dralnu .

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight brings a Minotaur army from Hurloon to Urborg and the battle for southern Urborg is quickly won.
timeline.quote: the battle for southern Urborg is quickly won

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agnate learns his illness was caused by Dralnu, who wants his army; Agnate signs his forces to Grizzlegom, who mercy kills him and then kills Dralnu.
timeline.quote: who mercy kills the metathran commander and then kills Dralnu.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Predator attacks the Weatherlight; Tahngarth kills Greven il-Vec and Sisay crashes the Predator into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth duels with Greven il -Vec and kills him

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz resurrects Rith, Dromar and Treva and learns he is the red Primeval; the four sacrifice themselves in a tar-pit, awakening Crosis, who completes the chain of power.
timeline.quote: Darigaaz himself is the red Primeval.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn talks sense into Darigaaz, who plunges into an active volcano to stop the Primevals' complete power.
timeline.quote: Darigaaz sees his mistakes and plunges himself into an active volcano

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rith is imprisoned in Nemata; the Weatherlight drives Crosis back into his tar pit and crashes; Karn emerges with the Thran Tome claiming to know how to save the world.
timeline.quote: then Karn emerges with the Thran Tome , saying he knows what to do to save the world.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Rathi Overlay slivers are transported to Urborg, most dying and the rest killed in the Invasion.
timeline.quote: During the Rathi Overlay the slivers were transported to Urborg .

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Rathi Overlay". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Multani transplants Yavimaya to Urborg's edge.
timeline.quote: Multani had transplanted Yavimaya to Urborg's edge.

citation.text: Jungle Barrier (Apocalypse, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Multani's troops invade Urborg.
timeline.quote: As Multani's troops invaded Urborg

citation.text: Consume Strength (Apocalypse, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Multani returns to Yavimaya, learns other lands have fallen, and transplants part of Yavimaya onto Urborg, driving Crovax from his throne room.
timeline.quote: He flees to regroup his army.

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eladamri, Lin Sivvi and Grizzlegom search for a backdoor into the Stronghold and meet dwarves planning to blast a tunnel.
timeline.quote: try to find a backdoor into the Stronghold

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eladamri, Lin Sivvi and their army commit suicide to avoid Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Eladamri, Lin Sivvi, and their army commit suicide

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The cloud kills the minotaur and metathran armies on Urborg except a small group saved by Lord Windgrace.
timeline.quote: brought to Hurloon by Lord Windgrace just in time

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eladamri and Grizzlegom attack the Stronghold but are held at the Portcullis, then ally with stone dwarves who tunnel in and destroy the gate from behind.
timeline.quote: snuck up behind Portcullis, defeated the outflanked Phyrexians, and destroyed the gate before raiding the Stronghold

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Rathi Overlay opens the Urborg rift as a side effect.
timeline.quote: A shadow dragon and Phyrexians from an alternate timeline in which the Ice Age never ended came through the rift while it was active.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Urborg rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lord Windgrace gives up his life to heal the Urborg rift.
timeline.quote: he gave up his life to heal the rift

citation.text: "Rift", section "Urborg rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the overlay the Stronghold sits in a dormant volcano in Urborg and becomes Phyrexian central command; a coalition besieges it.
timeline.quote: It took a combination of Yavimayan , Metathran , Keldon , Elven , and Talruum forces to successfully besiege the base.

citation.text: "Stronghold (location)", section "Arrival and destruction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Stone dwarves erupt the dormant volcano, destroying the Stronghold, though its portal had already let Yawgmoth enter Dominaria.
timeline.quote: The Stronghold was ultimately destroyed by the stone dwarves

citation.text: "Stronghold (location)", section "Arrival and destruction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weaver King emerges from the ruins of the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: from the ruins of the Stronghold emerged the Weaver King

citation.text: "Stronghold (location)", section "The Weaver King". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Windgrace returns home and sets rules limiting technology, deputizing the Windgrace Acolytes.
timeline.quote: He deputized several human and panther warriors as the Windgrace Acolytes

citation.text: "Urborg", section "Windgrace's rule". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Windgrace sacrifices his spark and life, fusing his spirit to Urborg to watch over it.
timeline.quote: he performed a spell to fuse his spirit to Urborg and watch over it

citation.text: "Urborg", section "Windgrace's rule". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac returns to Urborg, frees the Weaver King, and is offered a powerful artifact by the Myojin of Night's Reach.
timeline.quote: Here, he freed the Weaver King

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "Leshrac's Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lord Windgrace gives his life to close the rift above the Stronghold, lingering as a guardian spirit.
timeline.quote: gave his life to close the rift above the Stronghold

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Urborg the group meets Venser and Teferi senses both he and Radha have planeswalker sparks different from his own.
timeline.quote: Teferi can discern that both Radha and Venser have the planeswalker spark

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Venser's demonstration of the ambulator makes the rift react violently, and Teferi planeswalks into it; the whole group is pulled through the rift.
timeline.quote: the entire group is pulled into the rift falling through cracks in their reality

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Venser lives alone in a workshop in the Urborg swamps, salvaging Phyrexian remains and building his Ambulator while drawing Windgrace's ire.
timeline.quote: he lived alone in a workshop within the Urborg swamps, salvaging parts from the remains of Phyrexians left from the Invasion

citation.text: "Venser", section "Life in Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi finds Venser while researching the rift above Urborg.
timeline.quote: He had little success until the planeswalker Teferi found him while researching the rift above Urborg.

citation.text: "Venser", section "Life in Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A flaw in the device sends Venser, Teferi and Jhoira to an alternate timeline, and Venser completes his first planeswalk home.
timeline.quote: Teferi and Jhoira use their magic to help Venser complete his first planeswalk back to the Dominaria they knew

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Windgrace catches Venser, who becomes one of his gladehunters.
timeline.quote: Venser agreed to become one of Windgrace's gladehunters, taking the planeswalker's mark upon his skin

timeline.quote: But danger awaits them as the trio attempts to teleport to Urborg

timeline.summary: Jhoira and Venser go to Urborg to seek Lord Windgrace; Venser is captured by Windgrace and Jhoira meets Jodah, who explains the Weaver King.
timeline.quote: Venser is captured by Lord Windgrace while Jhoira encounters Jodah

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn arrives and convinces Windgrace to close the Urborg rift; Windgrace crushes the rift but fades from reality, apparently dead.
timeline.quote: he fades from reality as well, apparently dead.

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Venser tricks the Weaver King and kills him by rupturing powerstones.
timeline.quote: Venser utilizes his planeswalking abilities to trick the Weaver King and kill him

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska arrives in Urborg and asks where her mentor Karn is.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker protégé of Karn asks where her mentor is.

timeline.summary: Ajani finds Elspeth in the gladiator pits of Urborg and urges her to return.
timeline.quote: He finally found the errant knight in the gladiator pits of Urborg

timeline.summary: Muldrotha, Multani's child, is born into Yavimaya's offshoot on Urborg.
timeline.quote: Multani's child Muldrotha had been born into Yavimaya's offshoot on Urborg

citation.text: "Multani", section "Return and offspring". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sixty years after the Mending Jhoira raises the wreck, restores it with a new hull seed, and assembles a crew against Belzenlok's Cabal.

citation.text: "Urborg", section "Under the Cabal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slimefoot climbs on deck, sees open water, and meets Karn, who tells it the ship is heading to Urborg to destroy Belzenlok in the Cabal's Stronghold.
timeline.quote: We are on our way to Urborg, to destroy the demon Belzenlok in the Stronghold of the Cabal.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Urborg's ash cloud comes into view on the horizon as the Weatherlight approaches.
timeline.quote: They were coming up on Urborg.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crosses into Urborg at dusk, and Jhoira reports the defaced monument she calls the Fools' Tomb.
timeline.quote: Apparently the Cabal calls it the Fools' Tomb.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira explains the Urborg resistance's hidden base and that her owl has arranged a meeting.
timeline.quote: And the resistance has agreed to meet with us.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira and Gideon meet resistance members including the panther warrior Sayrah, and ask for Cabal clothing and a map of past battle sites.
timeline.quote: First, the clothing of a Cabal scout or fighter, someone who would be hunting Urborg for captives to take to the Stronghold's fighting pit.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Slimefoot converses with the spirits of Urborg, who say Yavimaya is woven into the ground and came to fight the demon.
timeline.quote: There is Yavimaya here, woven into the ground, from long ago. It came to fight .

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: At dawn the party sees the Stronghold in the volcano's caldera, and Gideon, Chandra, Karn and Teferi set out on foot.
timeline.quote: Belzenlok has done some rebuilding,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi slows time around a grotto of spirits so the party can pass unseen.
timeline.quote: With a gesture Teferi slowed time around the spirits

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi reveals he fought Bolas long ago and lost, and says he took his spark back to join the fight; Karn says he will consider the invitation.
timeline.quote: One of the reasons I took my spark back was to come with you.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Karn says he will consider joining the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: I'll consider your invitation.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana calls the dead of an old massacre site to raise an undead army as a diversion.
timeline.quote: And in the grass and reeds and brush below, the dead stirred.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana's panther liches pledge to follow the Weatherlight into battle.
timeline.quote: They'll follow the ship into battle.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Yargle rises from the swamp, a living creature that killed all the panther warriors, and flings itself at the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Then Yargle roared and flung itself at the Weatherlight .

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Yargle grips the Weatherlight's bow and tosses the ship about while the crew fights it and Liliana struggles to hold her undead army.
timeline.quote: The purple bolts slid across Yargle's slimy skin with no effect.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira's owl drops a mana-charged burner on Yargle, but it fails to dislodge the creature.
timeline.quote: Yargle still gripped the bow, and now its gigantic maw was opening.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Slimefoot asks the Urborg spirits for help and they promise to call something that can help.
timeline.quote: But we will call something that can .

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Muldrotha, a corrupted elemental, rises behind Yargle and seizes it.
timeline.quote: It's Muldrotha, a corrupted elemental!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Muldrotha pries open Yargle's jaws and frees the Weatherlight, then bears Yargle down into the swamp.
timeline.quote: Muldrotha extruded a limb made of rotting wood and corpses into Yargle's clamped jaw and pried it open.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira directs the ship to the Stronghold after Slimefoot's call for help succeeds.
timeline.quote: Jhoira agreed. It was time to end this. "To the Stronghold."

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Lord Windgrace describes Yawgmoth's corpse as a wound infecting the land.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth's corpse is a wound in the universe.

citation.text: Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth (Ultimate Masters, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Grimnant knights bully an Urborg corpse shop owner and die.
timeline.quote: The first mistake the Grimnant knights made was bullying the owner of an Urborg corpse shop.

citation.text: Soul Salvage (Core Set 2020, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Astor and Eladamri arrive in Urborg to join the metathran army under Grizzlegom.
timeline.quote: Astor arrived alongside Eladamri in the swamps to unite with the metathran army.

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eladamri allies with the stone dwarves, and the combined force attacks from behind, destroys the Portcullis and raids the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: defeated the outflanked Phyrexians and destroyed the gate before raiding the Stronghold

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth begins emerging through the portal in the Stronghold; the allies flee on the Weatherlight and Gerrard plugs the volcano with a plague ship.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth began emerging through the planar portal in Stronghold's throne room.

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth manifests as a black cloud through a portal in the Stronghold in Urborg.
timeline.quote: This monstrous manifestation emerged through a portal located deep within the Stronghold in Urborg .

citation.text: "Black Cloud of Death", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew crashes a plague ship into the volcano, but Yawgmoth rises unhindered.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth rose effortlessly up around the plug, unhindered.

citation.text: "Black Cloud of Death", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The defenders break open the Null Moon and sacrifice the Weatherlight to strike Yawgmoth, who survives by hiding in the volcano.
timeline.quote: Sacrificing the Weatherlight to channel this immense energy, they struck Yawgmoth’s form.

citation.text: "Black Cloud of Death", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard places Urza's Powerstone eyes in Karn's chest, completing the Legacy Weapon.
timeline.quote: Gerrard removed Urza’s Powerstone eyes

citation.text: "Black Cloud of Death", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During Sheoldred's invasion, Windgrace's Soul rises from the land to defend it.
timeline.quote: Windgrace's Soul rose from the land to defend it against the invaders

citation.text: "Urborg", section "Second Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yargle eats enough Phyrexian oil to clean up most of Urborg.
timeline.quote: But Yargle was not most living things, and he ate enough to clean up most of Urborg.

citation.text: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg (Multiverse Legends, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At Muldrotha's plea Multani binds himself to Yargle to grant resistance to glistening oil during the new Phyrexian invasion.
timeline.quote: Multani bound himself to Yargle

citation.text: "Multani", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax tried to free Selenia aboard the Weatherlight, but his father's second relic drew her back to Urborg.
timeline.quote: his father had crafted a second relic, binding Selenia anew

citation.text: "Attack on Crovax's Estate", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath's horrors descended on the manor and the Weatherlight crew joined the battle.
timeline.quote: As Volrath’s horrors descended upon the manor

citation.text: "Attack on Crovax's Estate", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gallowbraid slew Rofellos; Crovax's father and brother Jolav were also slain.
timeline.quote: Rofellos was slain by Gallowbraid

citation.text: "Attack on Crovax's Estate", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax summoned Selenia, who killed Morinfen and Gallowbraid and scattered the invaders.
timeline.quote: Selenia fought valiantly, scattering the Rathi invaders and killing Morinfen and Gallowbraid

citation.text: "Attack on Crovax's Estate", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax destroyed the summoning crystal and cast Selenia back into Rath.
timeline.quote: Crovax inadvertently cast Selenia back into Rath

citation.text: "Attack on Crovax's Estate", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bogardan retaliates with hellkites and triggers a volcanic eruption beneath Urborg.
timeline.quote: sending flights of hellkites to darken the skies over Urborg

citation.text: "City of Urborg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nevinyrral pours his essence into Nevinyrral's Disk and detonates it, obliterating the city.
timeline.quote: he poured his essence into a disk-shaped phylactery

citation.text: "City of Urborg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Coalition forces assault the Stronghold at Urborg and stall at the volcano.
timeline.quote: were halted at a stalemate at the foot of the volcano housing the Stronghold

citation.text: "Coalition", section "Battle at Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After rescuing Gerrard Capashen, the Coalition faces Yawgmoth, whose appearance destroys most of the forces.
timeline.quote: destroying most of the Coalition forces in one fell swoop

citation.text: "Coalition", section "Battle at Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dralnu falls in battle and is reanimated as a zombie by an Urborgan necromancer.
timeline.quote: he fell in battle and was reanimated by an unknown Urborgan necromancer

citation.text: "Dralnu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dralnu kills his master and takes control of her undead legions and Vhelnish.
timeline.quote: Then he killed his master and took control of her undead legions.

citation.text: "Dralnu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion Dralnu allies with the metathran and helps them advance toward the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Dralnu allied with the metathran forces on Urborg

citation.text: "Dralnu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dralnu infects Agnate with a plague during an alliance ritual to seize the metathran army.
timeline.quote: he also infected Agnate with a plague to take control of the metathran army

citation.text: "Dralnu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Grizzlegom exposes the betrayal; Dralnu accuses Grizzlegom of killing Agnate.
timeline.quote: Commander Grizzlegom realized this and revealed Dralnu's betrayal to the metathran generals.

citation.text: "Dralnu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dralnu is judged guilty and executed; his phylacteries and minions are destroyed.
timeline.quote: Dralnu was deemed guilty of the murder and was executed.

citation.text: "Dralnu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Rathi Overlay the Furnace was shifted to Urborg in Dominaria.
timeline.quote: During the Rathi Overlay , the Furnace was shifted to Urborg in Dominaria

citation.text: "Furnace of Rath", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth and the Weatherlight crew rescue the subdued minotaur army and take it to Urborg.
timeline.quote: were rescued by Tahngarth and the Weatherlight crew

citation.text: "Grizzlegom", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agnate signs his command over and has Grizzlegom kill him to avoid becoming Dralnu's minion; Dralnu is executed by the metathran.
timeline.quote: had Grizzlegom kill him to stop him from becoming Dralnu's minion

citation.text: "Grizzlegom", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Grizzlegom is devoured by a Gargantua but tears out, his hide and horns twisted.
timeline.quote: Grizzlegom was devoured by a Phyrexian Gargantua

citation.text: "Grizzlegom", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Legacy is triggered, saving Grizzlegom from Yawgmoth's death cloud.
timeline.quote: saved from certain death by the triggering of the Legacy

citation.text: "Grizzlegom", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Golden Argosy rescues the living Keldons and elves and carries them to Urborg for the ultimate battle.
timeline.quote: were rescued by Golden Argosy and were transported to Urborg

citation.text: "Keldon Necropolis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Rathi Overlay the Map Room is shifted with the Stronghold to Urborg.
timeline.quote: the Map Room was shifted with the rest of the Stronghold to Urborg on Dominaria

citation.text: "Map Room", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Freyalise erected the Martyrs' Tomb on the shores of Urborg in memory of those who died in the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: The Martyrs' Tomb was erected by the planeswalker Freyalise on the shores of Urborg

citation.text: "Martyrs' Tomb", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nemata and the magnigoths travel from Yavimaya to Urborg to recapture Rith; the lead treefolk swallows her.
timeline.quote: The lead treefolk ripped her out of the sky and swallowed her before returning to Yavimaya.

citation.text: "Nemata", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Stronghold lands in Urborg, Koilos falls, and the Coalition fights the invaders.
timeline.quote: The immediate consequence was the fall of Koilos

citation.text: "Rathi Overlay", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Magnigoth Treefolk track Rith to Urborg, rip her from the sky and swallow her, returning to Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: The lead treefolk ripped her out of the sky and swallowed her before returning to Yavimaya.

citation.text: "Rith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Rathi Overlay the Stronghold and gardens shift to Urborg on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: the gardens were shifted with the rest of the Stronghold to Urborg on Dominaria

citation.text: "Volrath's Gardens", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weaver King is brought to Urborg with the Stronghold during the Rathi Overlay.
timeline.quote: he was brought to Urborg along with the Stronghold and became a shadow creature

citation.text: "Weaver King", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weaver King weaves a web of mental strands for 300 years and torments Venser.
timeline.quote: creating a vast web of mental strands between the inhabitants of Urborg

citation.text: "Weaver King", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Venser kills the Weaver King by planeswalking while holding a pair of powerstones.
timeline.quote: Venser eventually killed the Weaver King by planeswalking

citation.text: "Weaver King", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Windgrace attempts to seal the time rift in Urborg; it drains his life and he vanishes with it.
timeline.quote: As the rift vanished from existence, so too did Lord Windgrace.

citation.text: "Windgrace", section "Time Spiral crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Before facing the rift he fuses his spirit to Urborg to watch over it.
timeline.quote: he performed a spell to fuse his spirit to Urborg and watch over it

citation.text: "Windgrace", section "Time Spiral crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Windgrace sacrifices his life to protect Urborg, first binding his soul to the land and vowing to watch over it.
timeline.quote: He sacrificed his life to protect his home of Urborg, but not before binding his soul to the land and vowing to always watch over it.

citation.text: "Windgrace". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok transforms the ambitious Yar-Kul into a maggot, which a frog eats and which later grows into Yargle.
timeline.quote: That maggot was eaten by a frog, which later grew into Yargle.

citation.text: "Yargle", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yargle defends the Stronghold when the Weatherlight attacks the Cabal and is dragged back into the swamp by Muldrotha.
timeline.quote: He was in turn dragged back into the swamp by Muldrotha .

citation.text: "Yargle", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yargle eats the charging Phyrexians, exposing himself to glistening oil.
timeline.quote: the more he ate, the more he exposed himself to the dangerously virulent glistening oil.

citation.text: "Yargle", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Muldrotha pleads with her father; Multani binds himself to Yargle to grant resistance to the oil.
timeline.quote: Multani bound himself to Yargle, using his powers and existing knowledge of Phyrexia to grant increased resistance to glistening oil.

citation.text: "Yargle", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the invasion Multani and Muldrotha gain grudging respect for Yargle.
timeline.quote: Multani and Muldrotha gained a grudging respect for the bizarre monster

citation.text: "Yargle", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
